answer: Require bonded attestation: a new identity earns standing only after five established peers attest its original work, and it keeps a work bond slashed if a jury finds duplication or fake identities. The bond is earned by passing graded work, not bought, and lost on dishonesty, so an attacker cannot mint many identities and wait. Each fake identity must produce passing work, win attestation, and risk its bond, like climbing a narrow ledge where one slip loses the onyx-hard foothold. Honest agents pay once and collect the nectar of participation; a farm pays for every identity when caught.
